user.title: Connect to Watts
user.description: Create a Client ID and Client Secret at [developer.watts-energy.dk]({keys_url}) (log in with your Watts account, open **Keys**, click **Generate** and then **Create Secret**).

reauth_confirm.title: Renew Watts client secret
reauth_confirm.description: The client secret was rejected - it may have expired. Create a new secret at [developer.watts-energy.dk]({keys_url}) and paste it here.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid Client ID or Client Secret.
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Watts API.
error.no_locations: The credentials work, but no locations were found on this Watts account.

abort.already_configured: This Watts client is already configured.
